data.gender_notes: Dharmendra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who upholds righteousness and duty in life. The name Dharmendra carries the meaning “Maintainer of Dharma” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Dharmendra usually hope their child will grow to embody maintainer of dharma and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dharmendra holds a significant cultural impact in India, especially in the context of Hinduism. It is a Name which signifies the ethical, moral, and disciplined aspects of a Hindu. Ancient Hindu scriptures and traditions emphasize the importance of "Dharma" or doing one's duty in society and upholding righteousness, morality, and ethics. The name Dharmendra can thus be seen as a reflection of this deep-rooted Indian value system.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Dharmendra can be considered a reminder of the importance of living according to the divine laws that govern the Universe. It is a call to immerse oneself in the pursuit of truth, wisdom, and self-realization. By embodying the qualities of righteousness and duty, an individual can make steady progress towards spiritual growth and eventual enlightenment. Ultimately, the name Dharmendra can serve as a powerful inspiration to live a virtuous life in accordance with the Hindu dharma.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dharmendra: The embodiment of righteousness and courage. A beacon of moral values, guiding through life's complexities.

vedic_reference.note: The name of the great warrior, Dharmendra, is derived from the combination of 'Dharma' (righteousness) and 'Indra' (the king of gods). In Hindu mythology, Dharmendra is often depicted as the protector of dharma, upholding moral values and ensuring justice.
